sourceFindings.finding: ModelRoute.select reads the trusted checkout's behavior/models.yaml bytes, validates the policy, and carries their SHA-256 as policyDigest. ModelRoute.delegationReceipt is the existing public producer; it selects research versus child by purpose, constructs the exact pinned research skill, and routes through the fake external Codex executor at the disposable CLI seam. The contract's canonical serviceTier is priority; the owned executor arguments map that to service_tier=fast.

The registered research.component-receipts scenario already dispatches through ModelRouteProbe.run. componentReceiptProbe binds AT-ops-44 to the actual A14 component, required decisions, seeded source report and an overlay checked by EngineeringControl.checkResearch. The delegationFixture supplies the existing nine-case route/skill matrix. The current component probe handles AT-ops-44's four case IDs only and does not bind requested.policyDigest to the current behavior/models.yaml bytes.

The public EngineeringControl.checkResearch path returns the seeded component/archive state and validates a report overlay against the original archive digest. Reuse it for A14; do not hand-copy source/archive DTOs or claim the private fixture helper itself is the acceptance interface.
The existing public probe dispatch supports a registered Hermes research.component-receipts acceptance. No new CLI command or module is needed.

minimumImplementation.componentBinding: Use EngineeringControl.checkResearch({release:'R0'}, context) to obtain the actual seeded A14 component, its current required decision and the original report/archive. Use the A14 research objective already owned by componentReceiptProbe for the seven research-purpose cases. For ordinary-implementation-luna, use a distinct ordinary A14 implementation/checklist objective and purpose implementation; do not reuse research wording. Build report overlays with the canonical ResearchComponentComparisonV3 schema, acceptance ID AT-ops-45 and G0:R0:A14 validation test ID AT-ops-45, then verify the public readback preserves the exact archive key/path/originalDigest and reports the exact overlay content digest. The ordinary and refused cases must not be presented as accepted A14 research.
minimumImplementation.policyAndReceiptAssertions: For research-route-observed and ordinary-implementation-luna, hash the exact trusted behavior/models.yaml bytes and require the receipt.invocation.requested.policyDigest to equal that digest. Research must show requested and observed gpt-6.1-sol/medium/priority, the full current behavior/research-skill.json pin and loaded resource digests, and the executor's fast-tier arguments; ordinary work must show requested and observed gpt-6-luna/max/priority, null research skill, and the same current policy digest. The canonical priority serviceTier is the contract representation of Fast. Keep nativeExecutionVerified=false and acceptanceComplete=false, and mark the synthetic fake-executor result fixture-only.
minimumImplementation.failureAssertions: Reuse the existing nine IDs and fault matrix. Missing route, Luna-for-research, wrong effort, and wrong tier must refuse the route subgate; missing or byte-mismatched skill must refuse before provider send; module-local settings override must return INVALID_INPUT before send. Keep the A14 original archive binding and expected route/skill validation outcomes observable for research report cases. Preserve ordinary implementation as a child route, not a research route. Do not add routes, thresholds, modules, contract/DTO shapes, private exported helpers, or a new receipt version.
minimumImplementation.evidenceShape: Emit ordinary compact CheckView evidence from the existing public owner. Keep each prerequisite at or below 2,000 characters and include the case ID, A14 archive key/original digest/overlay digest where applicable, policy digest, requested/observed route, skill pin/readback, provider send count, error code, and fixture-only/zero-live-send markers. Do not stringify the full receipt, copy DTO definitions, expose raw result text, or use a generic registration-only check.
